sentences.text: The genus Tingmiatornis contains only one species, T. arctica, which was described in 2016 and lived during the Turonian epoch of the Cretaceous.
Remains of Tingmiatornis were discovered on Axel Heiberg Island in the High Arctic of Nunavut, Canada.
Radiometric dating places the age of the rock layer containing the fossils at 92 million years ago.
Tingmiatornis belongs to the parent group Ornithurae.
Tingmiatornis is classified within the class Reptilia.
The time range for Tingmiatornis is estimated from 100.5 to 93.9 million years ago.
